title: Mitei Hattori's Smile! Manga Gets Epilogue Chapter
content:
Kyodo Printing Co., Ltd. 's Kodama Tales Inc. subsidiary releases the main Smile! manga in English, and it describes the story:

Yuushi Kamome is a freelance journalist who lost his beloved daughter in an unforeseen accident. His descent into despair following her death drove his wife to leave him, and he lives each day a shell of the man he once was. But his fate changes one day when members from a religious organization he had never heard of, the Smiling Hearts Society, knock on his door and hand him a flyer. He's ready to dismiss them until he notices the face of his estranged wife on the flyer, smiling ever so softly. And so begins a tale of religion and insanity. What kind of sinister darkness lurks behind this religion and its strange smiles?

Hattori launched the series in Nihonbungeisha 's Weekly Manga Goraku magazine in 2021. The series ended in March 2025. Nihonbungeisha shipped the 11th and final compiled book volume in March 2025. Kodama Tales released the fifth volume on September 1.
author: ANN

title: Life with an Ordinary Guy Who Reincarnated into a Total Fantasy Knockout Manga Ends With 20th Volume
content:
Seven Seas Entertainment is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the story:

Nerdy office worker Hinata has once again blundered at a singles mixer, no thanks to his hunky best friend, Jinguji, who's always by his side. While he's grumbling about it on the way home, a naked goddess appears out of nowhere and sends the two friends to another world--while also turning Hinata into a hot young woman! To get back Hinata's original body, Hinata and Jinguji set off on a journey to defeat the demon king, even if Hinata's new feminine form is giving them...unexpected feelings. Can they save this fantasy world before their lifelong bromance becomes a romance?

Tsurusaki and Ikezawa launched the manga in Cycomi in November 2019. Seven Seas Entertainment released the 10th volume on August 4.

The manga inspired a television anime that premiered in January 2022. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan, and also streamed an English dub .

title: 'A Pen, Handcuffs, and a Common-Law Marriage' TV Anime Reveals Theme Song Artists, More Cast, January 9 Debut in Video
content:
King Amusement Creative revealed the main promotional video on Friday for the television anime of storywriter Shinichi Sawaragi and artist Tanku Gasuyama 's A Pen, Handcuffs, and a Common-Law Marriage ( Pen to Wappa to Jijitsu Kon ) manga that reveals the anime's opening and ending theme song artists, more cast members, and January 9 debut. The company also revealed a key visual for the anime.

The anime will debut on January 9 at 25:00 (effectively January 10 at 1:00 a.m.) on Tokyo MX and BS11 .

Inori Minase performs the opening theme song “Mikaiketsu de, Romance de” (Unsolved and Romantic), and saeco performs the ending theme song “Message.”

The newly announced cast members include:

• Yūsuke Kobayashi as Wataru Kashikojima

• Sumire Morohoshi as Hinade Haruyama

• Sora Amamiya as Asuka Ishimuro

The anime will star Tomoaki Maeno as Eiji Kirisame and Inori Minase as Tsugumi Kuchinashi.

Takaaki Ishiyama ( Chaos;HEAd , Fairy Musketeers ) is directing the anime at EMT Squared . Shigeru Murakoshi ( Snowball Earth , Zombie Land Saga ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Miyuki Nakamura ( The Unaware Atelier Master ) is designing the characters. Hiroto Morishita ( The Faraway Paladin , Wistoria: Wand and Sword ) is the sound director and Kana Hashiguchi ( Classroom of the Elite (TV 3) , Black Fox ) is composing the music.

Yen Press announced in August 2025 it had licensed the manga, and it released the second compiled volume in English on September 22. The publisher describes the story:

Forty-year-old detective Eiji Kirisame has found maybe the strangest witness of his life: a silent high school girl named Tsugumi Kuchinashi who was at the scene of the crime. Her statements mostly consist of shoddy doodles on a drawing pad, but Eiji is no stranger to piecing together the truth from limited evidence. He'll take every page seriously if it might help solve the case. But why does the last page say... “Will you marry me?!”

Sawaragi and Gasuyama launched the manga in Hakusensha 's Young Animal magazine in December 2022. Hakusensha published the seventh volume on April 28 and will ship the eighth volume on December 25. The manga has 400,000 copies in circulation.

title: Kengo Matsumoto's >Jimoto no Ijimekko-tachi ni Shikaeshi Shiyō to Shitara Manga Gets TV Anime
content:
A website opened on Friday to announce that Kengo Matsumoto 's Jimoto no Ijimekko-tachi ni Shikaeshi Shiyō to Shitara, Betsu no Tatakai ga Hajimatta. (When I Tried to Get Payback Against My Hometown Bullies, Another Battle Began) manga (nicknamed "Ijihaji" for short) is getting a television anime adaptation that will air in 2027.

Chihiro Kumano ( The Kept Man of the Princess Knight , The Mononoke Lecture Logs of Chuzenji-sensei ) is directing the series at studio Gekkō . Kazuho Hyōdō ( TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You , ReLIFE ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Yūsaku Nakamura ( Makina-san’s a Love Bot?! ) is designing the characters.

Matsumoto launched the manga in March 2023 on the " Suiyōbi no Sirius " platform on Nico Nico Seiga . Kodansha will publish the 10th compiled volume on December 9.

The "new type of misunderstanding battle romantic comedy" manga centers on Kotarō Hinode, who when he was young was constantly humiliated in wrestling, basketball, and games by three children named Akira, Kanae, and Shigure, respectively. Now in high school, Kotarō vows to get back at them, and returns to his hometown. However, it turns out Akira, Kanae, and Shigure were not boys like Kotarō thought, but were girls. And now these three girls are young women who look like a gyaru, rich girl, and beautiful girl. In addition, all three start treating him kindly.

Tokyopop is publishing Matsumoto's My New Wife's Fake Smile manga in English, and Kodansha USA Publishing has released Matsumoto's How to Treat a Lady Knight Right manga in English.

title: Manga 'Jimoto no Ijimekko-tachi ni Shikaeshi Shiyou to Shitara, Betsu no Tatakai ga Hajimatta.' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content:
An official website opened for a television anime adaptation of Kengo Matsumoto 's Jimoto no Ijimekko-tachi ni Shikaeshi Shiyou to Shitara, Betsu no Tatakai ga Hajimatta. ( When Trying to Get Back at the Hometown Bullies, Another Battle Began ) manga on Friday, revealing the main staff and a teaser visual (pictured). The anime will premiere in 2027.

Staff Director: Chihiro Kumano ( Otonari no Tenshi-sama ni Itsunomanika Dame Ningen ni Sareteita Ken 2 ) Series Composition: Kazuho Hyoudou ( Kekkon suru tte, Hontou desu ka ) Character Design: Yuusaku Nakamura ( Kakushite! Makina-san!! ) Studio: Gekkou

Matsumoto originally published the romance comedy manga as a webcomic, abbreviated as Ijihaji , on their X (formerly Twitter) account in October 2022 before beginning serialization on the Suiyoubi no Sirius website in March 2023. Kodansha published the ninth volume on June 9, with the tenth volume scheduled for a December 9 release. Ijihaji has a cumulative 720,000 copies of its volumes in circulation.

Synopsis For most of his childhood, Kotarou Hinode has been relentlessly bullied by three boys: basketball prodigy Kanae Oborozuki, talented wrestler Akira Mikazuki, and gaming genius Shigure Mangetsu. Due to his competitive spirit, Kotarou challenges the trio in their respective fields, only to be defeated over and over again. Still, he remains steadfast, and before moving out, he vows that he will return stronger than ever.

Years later, as a high school student, Kotarou transfers back to his hometown, ready to fulfill his vengeance-fueled promise. In a twist of fate, it turns out that the three boys who bullied him back then are actually girls—only now more physically mature and attractive! This revelation does not deter him, however, and Kotarou remains focused on getting revenge. Furthermore, he is oblivious to the fact that the reason why Kanae, Akira, and Shigure used to push him around back then was that all three liked him—a feeling that has not faded in the present. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Rock Paper Landmine Novel Gets Stage Play in January
content:
Kadokawa announced on Friday that Yugo Aosaki 's Jirai Glico ( Glico with Landmines ) novel is getting a stage play adaptation that will run in Tokyo on January 22-24. Masahiko Kawahara is directing the play and Takayuki Kayano is writing the scripts.

The play will star: (left to right from top row, then middle row, then bottom row):

• Meari Hayashi as Mato Imoriya

• Ai Iinuma as Kazahi Kōda

• Junpei Mitsui as Hayato Kunugi

• mikina as Nieko Saburi

• Riria Itō (Nogizaka 46) as Esora Ukita

• Fumiya Takao (BUDDiiS) as Nuribe

• Kurita Kōhei (OCTPATH) as Haruo Niizuma

Kazuaki Seki is directing the series. Tatsuhiro Mishima, Shiori Ueno , and Daiki Kobayashi are writing the scripts, and Yuma Yamaguchi is composing the music. The Seven is producing the series and Akira Morii is the producer.

Kadokawa published the original novel in November 2023. The novel won three awards in 2024: the novel division of the 24th "Honkaku Mystery Taisho" (Orthodox Mystery Award) award, the "full-length novel or collected short stories" division of the 77th "Nihon Suiri Sakka Kyōkai Shō" (Mystery Writers of Japan Awards) award, and the 37th "Yamamoto Shūgorō Prize" award.

The Seven describes the story:

"Rock-Paper-Scissors," "Memory"... universally known simple games transform into the ultimate battles of strategy and psychology with just a few added rules! Mato Imoriya, a seemingly carefree high school girl with an uncanny talent for winning any game, plunges into underground school game battles to save her best friend, Kazahi Koda. What they stake isn't their "lives." It is their urgent "everyday lives" and "youth"—from securing prime spots for school festival booths to competing for 90 million yen worth of chips among students. High-level logic where a single step can be fatal, off-board tactics to outwit each other, and brilliant turnarounds that calmly flip the board from desperate situations. A "bloodless survival game" by high school girls who risk losing all their youth instead of their lives. The curtain rises on a thrilling, high-stakes battle-of-wits drama combining unpredictable tension with the catharsis of completely outwitting opponents!

Medaka Box artist Akira Akatsuki launched a manga adaptation of the novels in Hakusensha 's Young Animal magazine October 2024. The manga is ongoing and Hakusensha published the fifth volume on October 29.

Yugo Aosaki 's Undead Girl Murder Farce novels launched in 2015. Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the novels' manga adaptation. The novels inspired a television anime adaptation that debuted in July 2023. Crunchyroll streamed the series worldwide excluding Asia as it aired in Japan under the title Undead Murder Farce .

title: 'Pen to Wappa to Jijitsukon' Unveils Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, First Promo
content:
The official website of the Pen to Wappa to Jijitsukon ( A Pen, Handcuffs, and a Common-Law Marriage ) television anime unveiled additional cast, staff, the theme songs, a key visual (pictured), and first promotional video on Friday. The anime series adapting Shinichi Sawaragi and Tank Gasuyama 's comedy mystery manga will premiere on January 10 at 1:00 a.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by BS11.

Cast Wataru Kashima: Yuusuke Kobayashi ( Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu ) Hina Haruyama: Sumire Morohoshi ( Yakusoku no Neverland ) Asuka Ishimuro: Sora Amamiya ( Kanojo, Okarishimasu )

Staff Assistant Director: Masayuki Iimura ( Arifureta Shokugyou de Sekai Saikyou episode director) Prop Design: Masakazu Kobayashi ( Rakudai Kenja no Gakuin Musou sub character design) Art Director: Nakahara Yukiko ( Tearmoon Teikoku Monogatari art design) Color Design: Miho Hasegawa ( Otome Game Sekai wa Mob ni Kibishii Sekai desu ) Director of Photography: Satoshi Namiki ( Komi-san wa, Comyushou desu. ) Editing: Maki Sendo ( Class de 2-banme ni Kawaii Onnanoko to Tomodachi ni Natta )

Voice actress Inori Minase ( 5-toubun no Hanayome ) is performing the opening theme "Mikaiketsu de, Romance de." Heavy metal singer saeco is performing the ending theme "Message." Both theme songs are previewed in the first promotional video below.

Takaaki Ishiyama ( Rinkai! ) is directing the anime at EMT Squared , with Shigeru Murakoshi ( Apocalypse Hotel ) handling the series composition. Miyuki Nakamura ( Kanchigai no Atelier Meister ) is designing the characters. Hiroto Morishita ( Nihon e Youkoso Elf-san. ) is serving as the sound director, while Kana Hashiguchi ( Kamiina Botan, Yoeru Sugata wa Yuri no Hana ) composing the music.

Sawaragi and Gasuyama began serializing the manga in Young Animal in December 2022. Hakusensha published the seventh volume on April 28, with the eighth volume scheduled for a December 25 release. Pen to Wappa to Jijitsukon has a cumulative 500,000 copies of its volumes in circulation.

Yen press licensed the manga in English in August 2025. The second volume went on sale on September 22, with the third volume scheduled to be released on December 15.

title: Mercedes and the Waning Moon TV Anime Reveals More Cast, January 10 Debut
content:
Hakuhodo DY Music & Pictures revealed the second main visual and three more cast members on Friday for the television anime adaptation of Firehead 's Mercedes and the Waning Moon: The Dungeoneering Feats of a Discarded Vampire Aristocrat ( Kaketa Tsuki no Mercedes: Kyūketsuki no Kizoku ni Tensei Shita kedo Suteraresō nanode Dungeon wo Seiha suru ) light novel series.

The company also revealed the anime will debut on TBS and 27 other affiliate channels on January 10 at 4:30 p.m. The series will stream on services like ABEMA , d Anime Store , and U-NEXT in Japan after its television broadcast on Sundays at 5:00 p.m. starting on January 10.

The new cast includes (character name romanizations are not confirmed):

Nichika Ōmori as Margitte, Mercedes' younger sister

Miyu Tomita as Monica, Mercedes' younger sister

Show Hayami as Bernhard, Mercedes' father and a feudal lord

The anime will star:

• Anna Nagase as the titular Mercedes Grunewald

• Kenta Miyake as Benkei

• Ryūnosuke Watanuki as Kuro

• Junichi Suwabe as Florian

• Ai Kayano as Ryudia

Kunihisa Sugishima ( Strike Witches , Yu-Gi-Oh! , Beyblade: Metal Fury ) is directing the anime at Teddy . Jun Kumagai ( Persona 4 the Golden Animation , Aquarion Logos ) is in charge of series scripts, Nami Shōyama (animation director for Buddy Daddies , Yu-Gi-Oh! Go Rush!! , Yu-Gi-Oh! Sevens ) is designing the characters, and R.O.N ( The Classroom of a Black Cat and a Witch , Kuroko's Basketball ) and Shūhei Mutsuki ( The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You ; Lycoris Recoil ) are composing the music.

J-Novel Club publishes the novel series in English digitally and describes the story:

Reincarnated as a vampire to a noble father and his shunned concubine, Mercedes Grunewald has always known that one day, her father will choose an heir that isn't her. But what will become of her family when that time comes? Her mother has no skills, their maid is old, and Mercedes is but a small child. How will they survive in the world on their own? Luckily, dungeon crawling is a job that anyone can do—even a child. To provide for her family, Mercedes begins training at the age of a kindergartener, and because she's from a nation of vampires, she fortunately has the potential to become strong. In her past life, she died unfulfilled, but that won't be her fate this time. In the dungeons, she's determined to find something that will make her moon full.

Firehead launched the series on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in 2018. TO Books started publishing the novels with illustrations by KeG in 2021. TO Books released the fifth novel volume digitally on July 15, and will publish the sixth volume on January 15.

Pochi Edoya launched the novel series' manga adaptation on TO Books ' Comic Corona (now Corona EX ) website in 2021. TO Books published the manga's sixth compiled book volume on July 15, and will publish the seventh volume on January 15.

J-Novel Club publishes the novel series in English digitally and describes the story:

Reincarnated as a vampire to a noble father and his shunned concubine, Mercedes Grunewald has always known that one day, her father will choose an heir that isn't her. But what will become of her family when that time comes? Her mother has no skills, their maid is old, and Mercedes is but a small child. How will they survive in the world on their own? Luckily, dungeon crawling is a job that anyone can do—even a child. To provide for her family, Mercedes begins training at the age of a kindergartener, and because she's from a nation of vampires, she fortunately has the potential to become strong. In her past life, she died unfulfilled, but that won't be her fate this time. In the dungeons, she's determined to find something that will make her moon full.

Firehead launched the series on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in 2018. TO Books started publishing the novels with illustrations by KeG in 2021. TO Books released the fifth novel volume digitally on July 15, and will publish the sixth volume on January 15.

title: 2027 Doraemon Film Reveals Guest Cast
content:
The staff for Eiga Doraemon: Nobita no Jōki Jikansha ( Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's Steam Time Locomotive), the 2027 Doraemon film , revealed the film's guest cast on Friday.

The guest cast includes (listed left to right in top row and then bottom row, character name romanizations are not confirmed):

• Chikahiro Kobayashi as Welson, a novelist and inventor living in 19th century England

• Tomoyo Kurosawa as Tim, a shy child studying under Welson

• Aoi Yūki as Lily, a cheerful child studying under Welson

• Kenshō Ono as Doug, a child studying under Welson who prides himself on his strength

• Riko Fujitani as Nick, a child studying under Welson who loves mischief

The film will open in Japan on March 5, 2027.

The new film's story begins as Nobita and his friends time-travel to 19th-century Victorian London.

Rushio Moriyama , a storyboarder and episode director for a number of episodes of the Doraemon anime since 2020, is directing the film. Makoto Ueda ( The Tatami Galaxy , Tatami Time Machine Blues , Penguin Highway ) is penning the film's script.

The 2026 Doraemon film , Eiga Doraemon: Shin Nobita no Kaitei Kiganjō ( Doraemon the Movie: New Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil ), opened in Japan on February 27.

title: 2nd New Armored Trooper Votoms Anime Film to Open in 2027
content:
The staff for Sunrise and Production I.G 's Sōkō Kihei Votoms Haiiro no Hexe ( Armored Trooper Votoms : Die Graue Hexe or literally, Armored Trooper Votoms : The Grey Witch), the two new anime films in the Armored Trooper Votoms franchise, revealed on Friday the second film will open in 2027.

The first film opened in Japan on Friday. Sunrise began streaming a new trailer for the film on Thursday. The trailer features narration by Banjō Ginga .

The anime's website also revealed a teaser visual for the second film (below right), pictured alongside the visual for the first film (left).

Miyuki Sawashiro plays Ash Vamps (featured in visual right), a notorious and feared AT pilot called the Grey Witch. Mabuki Andou plays Maki Stauffenberg, an officer secretly assigned to look into Ash's past.

Other cast members include:

• Shinichirō Miki as Alix Barrack

• Yūki Kaji as Ignis Schweinsteiger

• Yūichi Nakamura as Fritz Gersdorf

• Satoshi Tsuruoka as Brunhart Müller

• Tomokazu Sugita as Adrian Dysler

• Kenta Miyake as Matt Hummels

• Chafūrin as Soltig van Gunnar

• Hōchū Ōtsuka as Vid Hildebrandt

• Daisuke Ono as Meteusz Julian Podolsky

• Takayuki Sugō as Weissweiler

• Takahiro Sakurai as Oliver

• Sumire Uesaka as Maintenance Girl

Mamoru Oshii is directing the two films. Ryōsuke Takahashi , director and creator of the original concept for the original 1983 Armored Trooper Votoms anime, is supervising the films. Shinobu Tsuneki ( The Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These , Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex , Kaiju No. 8 ) and Sōkō Kihei Votoms: AT Stories manga artist Yoshiro Sōno are the mechanical designers. Kenji Kawai , who has worked with Oshii in various projects including Ghost in the Shell and Patlabor 2: The Movie , is composing the music. Mika Nakashima performs the first film's theme song "Na mo Naki Shijin no Yō ni" (Like Some Nameless Poet). Toshihiko Takamizawa , the vocalist and guitarist for the band THE ALFEE , wrote, composed, and arranged the song.

Other staff include:

• Original Character Design Concepts: Kazuchika Kise (xxxHOLiC, Made in Abyss, Fate/Grand Order The Movie Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot)

• Character Design: Shingo Ogiso, Takashi Kojima, Tetsuya Nishio

• Original Mechanical Designer: Kunio Ōkawara

• Mechanical Design: Jū Ishiguchi, Wataru Inada

• Costume Design Assistance: Katsuya Terada

• Art Design: Satoshi Takabatake, Yasumitsu Suetake, Kazushige Kanehira

• Art Director: Yūshi Honjō

• Color Key Artist: Nagisa Abe

• Compositing Director of Photography: Yūki Kawashita

• CG Directors: Yōta Tasaki, Toshihisa Yokoshima, Jō Nakajima

• Editing: Aya Hida

• Sound Director: Kazuhiro Wakabayashi

The 1983 Armored Trooper Votoms anime is an iconic entry in the so-called "real robot" subgenre of mecha pioneered by Mobile Suit Gundam , characterized by robots as mass-produced military machines (with limitations in operation akin to real-life war machines) and gritty and grounded stories about war and its bitter costs.

The original 1983 anime is set during the ebb of a century-long conflict between the two nations of the Gilgamesh Confederation and the Balarant Union. The unit that dominates the battlefield is the VOTOMS (Vertical One-man Tank for Offense & Maneuvers), a class of powerful yet extremely vulnerable mecha, known as much for their firepower as they are for the high casualty numbers of their pilots due to thin armor and lack of safety measures. The protagonist, Chirico Cuvie, is a member of an elite Gilgamesh VOTOMS unit that becomes a pawn in a vast conspiracy that brands him a traitor to Gilgamesh, and leads him to cross paths with a mysterious woman.

Section23 Films ' Maiden Japan label most recently released the original anime on Blu-ray Disc in 2019 and 2020.

The original series has inspired a number of spinoff anime, including Armored Trooper Votoms: The Last Red Shoulder , Armored Trooper Votoms: Big Battle , Armor Hunter Mellowlink , Armored Trooper Votoms: Red Shoulder Document - Roots of Treachery , Armored Trooper Votoms: Pailsen Files , and Armored Trooper Votoms: The Heretic Saint . Armored Trooper Votoms: Alone Again , the latest entry in the series until now, debuted in 2011.
